title: Ebola Outbreak in the DRC Reaches Critical Levels
subtitle: Health officials work to launch vaccine trials as the epidemic spreads faster than ever before.

summary.en: A serious Ebola outbreak is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Health experts warn that this could soon become the largest epidemic in history. Authorities are now working to start a large clinical trial for a vaccine. This study aims to test if a known vaccine can protect people from this specific type of the virus. Officials hope these efforts will help save lives and stop the disease from spreading further.
summary.zh: 一場嚴重的伊波拉疫情正在剛果民主共和國迅速蔓延。衛生專家警告，這可能很快會成為史上規模最大的流行病。當局目前正致力於啟動一項大型疫苗臨床試驗。這項研究旨在測試現有的疫苗是否能保護民眾免受此特定病毒株的侵害。官員希望這些努力能有助於拯救生命，並阻止疾病進一步擴散。

paragraphs.en: A dangerous Ebola outbreak is currently moving through the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). According to STAT News, health officials are working quickly to start a major clinical trial for a vaccine. This effort aims to help control the spread of the Bundibugyo virus, which is the specific type of Ebola currently affecting the northeast part of the country.
paragraphs.zh: 一場危險的伊波拉病毒疫情目前正在剛果民主共和國（Democratic Republic of the Congo, DRC）蔓延。根據 STAT 新聞報導，衛生官員正加緊腳步，準備針對一款疫苗啟動大型臨床試驗。這項計畫旨在協助控制邦迪布焦病毒（Bundibugyo virus）的擴散，這正是目前影響該國東北部地區的特定伊波拉病毒類型。

paragraphs.en: The situation is becoming very serious. STAT News reports that the leader of the global health agency warned that this outbreak is moving faster than any previous one. If it continues at this speed, it is expected to become the largest Ebola epidemic ever recorded. It is already the second-biggest in history, and experts fear it could soon pass the large West African outbreak that occurred between 2014 and 2016.
paragraphs.zh: 情勢正變得非常嚴峻。STAT 新聞報導指出，全球衛生機構的負責人警告，此次疫情的擴散速度比以往任何一次都要快。若疫情持續以這種速度發展，預計將成為有紀錄以來規模最大的伊波拉流行病。目前這已是史上第二大疫情，專家擔憂它很快就會超越二零一四年至二零一六年期間發生在西非的大規模疫情。

paragraphs.en: To fight the disease, experts are looking at a vaccine called Ervebo, made by the company Merck. This vaccine was originally designed to target a different species of the virus, known as Ebola Zaire. While an expert panel was initially unsure about using it for the current outbreak, new studies in animals and humans have provided more confidence. Researchers now believe the vaccine might offer some protection against the Bundibugyo virus. The goal of the upcoming Phase 3 clinical trial—a large-scale test to ensure a medical treatment is safe and effective—is to confirm if this vaccine can truly help people.
paragraphs.zh: 為了對抗這種疾病，專家們正關注一款由默克藥廠（Merck）製造、名為 Ervebo 的疫苗。該疫苗最初是為了針對另一種病毒株「薩伊伊波拉病毒」（Ebola Zaire）所設計。雖然專家小組起初對於將其用於此次疫情感到疑慮，但針對動物與人類的新研究已提供了更多信心。研究人員現在認為，該疫苗或許能針對邦迪布焦病毒提供一定的保護力。即將進行的第三期臨床試驗，其目標是透過大規模測試來確保醫療處置的安全與有效性，進而證實這款疫苗是否真的能幫助民眾。

paragraphs.en: The numbers behind this outbreak are concerning. STAT News reports that as of Monday, there have been more than 4,500 confirmed cases of Ebola. The virus is centered in the Ituri province, which is located near the borders of Uganda and South Sudan. Sadly, more than 2,060 of those people have died from the disease. Because of these high numbers, officials are working hard to get approval for the trial from local authorities and ethics committees in the DRC.
paragraphs.zh: 這場疫情背後的數據令人擔憂。STAT 新聞報導指出，截至週一，已確認的伊波拉病例超過四千五百例。病毒集中在伊圖里省（Ituri），該省鄰近烏干達與南蘇丹邊界。遺憾的是，已有超過兩千零六十人死於此病。由於確診與死亡人數眾多，官員正努力向剛果民主共和國當地的相關部門與倫理委員會爭取試驗批准。

paragraphs.en: If the study receives approval, researchers plan to use a method called individual randomization. This means that people who have been in contact with an infected person will be chosen by chance to receive either the vaccine or a placebo—a substance that has no medical effect, used as a comparison in tests. This approach is considered more efficient than previous methods used in earlier outbreaks. As other vaccines that specifically target the Bundibugyo virus become available, they will also be added to the study.
paragraphs.zh: 若研究獲得批准，研究人員計畫採用「個人隨機分配」的方法。這意味著曾與感染者接觸的人，將透過隨機方式被選中，分別接種疫苗或安慰劑（一種無醫療效果、用於測試對照的物質）。這種方法被認為比以往疫情中採用的方式更有效率。隨著其他專門針對邦迪布焦病毒的疫苗問世，這些疫苗也將被納入研究範圍。

paragraphs.en: There is also a separate discussion regarding how to use the vaccine. STAT News noted that authorities in the DRC have expressed a desire to provide Ervebo for general use outside of a formal clinical trial. This idea has received support from the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. However, it remains unclear if the DRC can get enough doses of the vaccine to make this plan possible. Currently, there is a stockpile of about 500,000 doses, but these are managed by an international group that controls vaccine supplies.
paragraphs.zh: 關於如何使用疫苗，目前還有另一項討論。STAT 新聞提到，剛果民主共和國當局已表達希望在正式臨床試驗之外，能將 Ervebo 提供給一般大眾使用。此想法已獲得非洲疾病管制暨預防中心（Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention）的支持。然而，剛果民主共和國是否能取得足夠的疫苗劑量來實現此計畫，仍不明朗。目前雖有約五十萬劑的庫存，但這些疫苗是由一個國際組織所控管。

paragraphs.en: For now, the focus remains on the clinical trial. Experts emphasize that the trial is the best way to ensure that a safe and effective vaccine is available as soon as possible. By testing the vaccine in a controlled way, scientists hope to gather the evidence needed to protect the public. As the outbreak continues to grow, the international community is watching closely, hoping that these new medical steps will help bring the crisis to an end and prevent future suffering.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，焦點仍放在臨床試驗上。專家強調，試驗是確保能儘快取得安全且有效疫苗的最佳途徑。透過受控的疫苗測試，科學家希望能收集到保護大眾所需的證據。隨著疫情持續擴大，國際社會正密切關注，期盼這些新的醫療措施能協助終結危機，並防止未來的苦難。

keyTerms.definitionEn: Spreading or advancing through a specific area.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「移動」，這裡指疾病的擴散。文中：A dangerous Ebola outbreak is currently moving through the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

keyTerms.definitionEn: To exceed or go beyond a previous record or level.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「通過」，這裡指超越某個歷史數據。文中：and experts fear it could soon pass the large West African outbreak that occurred between 2014 and 2016.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Concentrated or located primarily in a specific place.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（中心），這裡作動詞表示疫情集中地。文中：The virus is centered in the Ituri province, which is located near the borders of Uganda and South Sudan.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A large supply of goods kept for future use.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此字由 stock（庫存）與 pile（堆）組成，指為了應急而大量囤積的物資。文中：Currently, there is a stockpile of about 500,000 doses, but these are managed by an international group that controls vaccine supplies.

sources.name: STAT News
sources.title: Talks on launch of clinical trial of Ebola vaccine in DRC advance, WHO says

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of the upcoming Phase 3 clinical trial mentioned in the article?

options.A: To distribute the Ervebo vaccine to the general public immediately.
options.B: To determine if the Ervebo vaccine is safe and effective against the Bundibugyo virus.
options.C: To compare the effectiveness of the Bundibugyo virus against Ebola Zaire.
options.D: To secure more funding for the international group managing vaccine stockpiles.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，Phase 3 clinical trial 的目標是「ensure a medical treatment is safe and effective」，且研究人員希望確認該疫苗是否能對抗 Bundibugyo 病毒。選項 A 錯誤，因為臨床試驗是為了測試而非直接大規模分發；選項 C 錯誤，因為試驗並非比較兩種病毒，而是測試疫苗對該病毒的效力；選項 D 在文中並未提及。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why might the goal of providing Ervebo for general use outside of a clinical trial be difficult to achieve?

options.A: The vaccine has been proven ineffective against the Bundibugyo virus.
options.B: Local authorities in the DRC are strictly against the use of any vaccines.
options.C: There is uncertainty regarding the sufficiency of the available vaccine supply.
options.D: The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention opposes the idea.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，儘管剛果民主共和國（DRC）希望將疫苗用於臨床試驗之外，但文章明確指出「it remains unclear if the DRC can get enough doses of the vaccine to make this plan possible」。選項 A 與文章說法矛盾；選項 B 錯誤，因為當地政府其實是支持廣泛使用的；選項 D 錯誤，因為該機構其實是支持這項提議的。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'placebo' mean in the context of the clinical trial?

options.A: A dangerous substance that causes side effects.
options.B: A medicine that is proven to cure the disease.
options.C: A substance with no medicinal value used for comparison.
options.D: A new, experimental vaccine being tested for the first time.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第五段括號內的解釋，「a substance that has no medical effect, used as a comparison in tests」，這就是安慰劑（placebo）的定義。選項 A 錯誤，安慰劑不具備醫療效果，通常也不會造成危險；選項 B 錯誤，安慰劑並非藥物；選項 D 錯誤，安慰劑是用來對照的基準，而非測試的目標藥物。

quiz.question: What is the central focus of the article regarding the Ebola outbreak in the DRC?

options.A: The history of Ebola outbreaks in West Africa from 2014 to 2016.
options.B: The challenges and efforts to test a vaccine as a response to the current outbreak.
options.C: The political conflict between the DRC and international health agencies.
options.D: The biological differences between the Bundibugyo virus and Ebola Zaire.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。整篇文章從疫情的嚴重性出發，重點討論了醫學界如何透過臨床試驗（clinical trial）來測試 Ervebo 疫苗，並探討了該策略的執行細節與挑戰。選項 A 只是背景資訊；選項 C 過度解讀，文中並未強調政治衝突；選項 D 僅是文中提到的一小部分技術細節，並非全文核心。
